title: Narayan Bali Puja in Gaya — Meaning, Procedure, Cost & Untimely Death Rites
metaDescription: Complete guide to performing Narayan Bali Puja in Gaya. Learn about rites for untimely death, accidental death, Garuda Purana rules, cost, and Gayawal Pandit booking.
author: Acharya Pandit V. K. Gayawal
summary: Narayan Bali Puja is a specialized Vedic ritual performed in Gaya to liberate souls who suffered unnatural, premature, or accidental deaths. Learn the complete procedure, mandatory samagri, and Gayawal Pandit coordination.
content:
Narayan Bali Puja in Gaya is an essential Vedic rite specified in the Garuda Purana and Dharma Sindhu for souls who passed away due to accidents, sudden illnesses, unnatural causes, or before fulfilling their life span. When a person dies an unnatural death, standard Shradh rites may not reach the soul, leaving it trapped in a restless Pret state.

### Why Gaya is Supreme for Narayan Bali
Gaya is blessed by Lord Vishnu's footprint (Vishnupad) and Brahma Kund. Performing Narayan Bali under certified Gayawal Pandits invokes Lord Vishnu using a golden idol (Suvarna Murti) of Lord Narayana, breaking the karmic bondage of untimely decease.

sections.heading: Indications That Require Narayan Bali Puja
sections.body: Frequent nightmares of deceased family members, unexplained business losses, persistent health issues, or repetitive lineage blockages indicate unsatisfied ancestral souls needing Narayan Bali.

sections.heading: Step-by-Step Procedure of Narayan Bali in Gaya
sections.body: The ritual spans 1 to 2 days. It begins with Sankalpa at Brahma Kund, followed by installation of 5 Kalashas representing Vishnu, Brahma, Shiva, Yama, and Pret. 16 Pinda offerings are performed along with Brahmin Bhojan and gold idol charity.

faqs.question: Can Narayan Bali be performed together with regular Pind Daan?
faqs.answer: Yes, Gayawal Pandits often combine Narayan Bali with standard Gaya Pind Daan over a 2-day pilgrimage schedule.

faqs.question: What is the cost of Narayan Bali Puja in Gaya?
faqs.answer: Complete Narayan Bali packages start at ₹15,500, covering Pandit Dakshina, golden idol, 5-Kalash samagri, and Brahmin Bhojan.

sources: Garuda Purana (Preta Khanda - Narayan Bali Vidhi)
